description_en: Validates an access policy and returns a list of analysis results
description_zh: 请求验证策略并返回分析结果列表
kebab_example: aliyun accessanalyzer validate-policy --policy-document '{"Version":"1","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"ecs:*","Resources":"*"}]}' --policy-type IdentityBasedPolicy --validate-policy-resource-type ACS::OSS::Bucket --max-results 10 --next-token eyJpbmRleCI6IjIifQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ValidatePolicy

parameters.help_en: The content of the access policy to validate. The maximum length is 61,440 characters
parameters.help_zh: 要校验的权限策略内容，存在字符上限，为61440字符
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en: The resource type. This parameter can be specified only when PolicyType is set to ResourceBasedPolicy. This enables more precise validation of resource-based policies
parameters.help_zh: 指定资源类型，仅当 PolicyType 为 ResourceBasedPolicy 时可指定，用于进行更精确的资源策略校验
parameters.name: validate_policy_resource_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of validation results to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大校验结果数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，首次请求不填，后续请求使用上一次返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token
